title: All-moduli Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.8738357029730854
description: Dirichlet nonvanishing for every positive modulus and every character when Re(s) > 4369178514865427/5000000000000000, excluding only the principal pole. The proof combines a selected ordinary-source sextic norm at a fixed positive amplitude gap, repeated-mark zero counting, feedback from proved global Hecke bounds, and finite source transfer along strictly certified polynomial curves. A complete rational return uses separate counting and physical source faces. The final theorem discharges all analytic and source-provider inputs. The work builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, ArviFoxy, Sil and Jacob Sussman; inherited notices and licenses are retained. The research and Lean development were AI-assisted.
